name: sgs/cta-section
title: SGS CTA Section
description: Call-to-action section with headline, supporting text, and buttons.

sgs._comment_overlayNotAdopted: backgroundImage/Size/Position/Repeat/Attachment, backgroundOverlay*, bgVideo*/bgSvg*/bgParallax/bgKenBurns are the shared whole-block BACKGROUND PANEL (rendered by class-sgs-container-wrapper.php's sgs_overlay_decls()), not media elements -- same settled reasoning as sgs/container (see its block.json for the full note, 2026-09-03, Bean-directed). Detector rule 37-media-no-handroll's bare `background`/`bg`-prefix discriminator excludes this whole family from supports.sgs.mediaElements by design.

wrapper.label: Wrapper
wrapper._note: block.json's own Selectors API deliberately splits colour: color.background/color.text are scoped to the wrapper root (.wp-block-sgs-cta-section) so buttons/body/ribbon inherit text colour by cascade, while typography (fontSize/lineHeight/etc) is re-selectored to .sgs-cta-section__headline — see the 'headline' element below for that half of the split.
wrapper._note_animation: FR-35-6 — anim:parallax/anim:duration resolve via bgParallax/bgAnimationDuration (explicit attrMap; no `prefix` declared, per ROLLOUT REQUIREMENT 1). bgKenBurns is a separate preset toggle with no animation-cluster member and stays unmapped. anim:preset/anim:easing/anim:stagger/anim:trigger are honest gaps — no sgsAnimation*/staggerDelay/scroll-trigger attrs on this block.

headline.label: Headline
headline._note_textcolour: css:color intentionally UNMAPPED. It previously pointed at native:color.text, which was switched off here so the native colour UI would not compete with the block's SgsColourPanel text row (rule 31). Leaving the pointer would have recreated the dead binding fixed on sgs/container in 0f2c167f. The headline now INHERITS the root text colour the wrapper sets (D713) — a real gap report on this element is honest, a wrong mapping is not.

body.label: Body text
body._note: Rendered by the InnerBlocks sgs/text child (.sgs-cta-section__body). It has no dedicated typography/colour attrs of its own on this block — it inherits the wrapper's native text colour and the theme's body typography by cascade, mirroring quote's 'quote-body' pattern.

ribbon.label: Ribbon
ribbon._note: The ribbon attribute is a plain string with no dedicated style attrs — it renders with fixed component styling, not a per-instance Text/Fill/Layout control set.

buttons.label: Buttons
buttons._note: Each buttons[] item carries a 'style' preset token (e.g. accent/outline), not per-instance colour/typography/layout attrs — button appearance is driven by the shared button-style tokens, outside the Text/Fill/Layout style clusters.

inner.label: Inner (grid / flex layout)
inner._note: Grid/arrangement members map explicitly because this element declares no `prefix` — the default {prefix}{Suffix} convention cannot resolve a bare camelCase attribute. These are layout-cluster members: role=layout on a GRID element means arranging children, which the ELEMENT axis disambiguates from box-sizing on a tile element. Members with no attribute on this block (display, order, overflow, align-items) remain honest GAPs.

decorative.label: Decorative background
decorative._note: Background image/video (backgroundImage*/backgroundMedia/bgVideo*), background SVG (bgSvg*), overlay gradient/colour (overlayGradient*/backgroundOverlay*), parallax/Ken Burns, and shape dividers (shapeDivider*) are governed by dedicated controls outside the Text/Fill/Layout style clusters.

overlay.label: Background image overlay
overlay._note: The `<span class="sgs-cta-section__overlay">` scrim rendered over the background image (render.php:338-339, `--sgs-cta-overlay-opacity`). Added 2026-08-15 — no manifest element previously covered it. `css:background-image` -> `overlayGradient` added 2026-08-16 (D643): the /sgs-update reseed that session classified `overlayGradient` as role='colour-gradient' for the first time, which made it visible to this gate as an unclaimed STYLE-DEFECT orphan. It was never claimed by anything — the scrim is exactly the element that paints it (the same `background-image` the shared wrapper emits for the other five collapsed blocks). Mapped explicitly, mirroring sgs/hero's `overlay` element, rather than by adding a `fill` cluster — `clusters: []` is deliberate here and adding one would recreate the CONTESTED-vs-`wrapper` collisions hero's own note records. `prefix: ""` added in the same change and is the half that actually clears the orphan: with `clusters: []` there are no resolvable members, so an attrMap entry alone never reaches `claimedAttrs` (verified by running the gate — the attrMap on its own left the finding at 13). The empty prefix opts the element out of orphan-candidate scanning, exactly as sgs/hero's `overlay` does; the attrMap stays because it is the honest record of which attribute paints this element. `css:opacity`'s `BackgroundImageOpacity` suffix (fill cluster, widened D561 2026-08-11 naming this exact attribute as the target) already anticipated this attribute but no element existed to carry it; mapped explicitly rather than via the default `{prefix}Suffix` convention since this element has no natural prefix of its own (`background` belongs to the wrapper's own background-image controls, not this scrim).

attributes._comment_backgroundMedia: Migrated 2026-05-05 â€” backgroundImage retained for deprecation. New instances should use backgroundMedia (accepts image OR video).

backgroundImageDecorative._comment: Spec 35 item 18 / {element}Decorative convention. render.php paints this image purely as a CSS background-image (never a frontend tag), which is inherently decorative to assistive tech with no alt attribute involved — default true documents that. The only literal is the operator-only MediaPicker preview thumbnail in edit.js's InspectorControls, which this attribute drives directly.

borderColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the hover border instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over borderColourHover on :hover/:focus-within (D636). There is no resting-state sibling — the base border colour is governed by the native supports.__experimentalBorder colour control.

textColourGradient.description: CSS gradient painting the resting root text colour (background-clip: text) instead of a flat colour. Non-empty WINS over textColour at render time, mirroring sgs/hero and sgs/container.

textColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient for the hover root text colour. Non-empty wins over textColourHover.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.
